text:
maya: Hey team — first day network snag. I can hit public internet but can't reach internal config-service (http://config.internal:8080). Getting timeout. I'm on macOS Ventura at home on ISP X. Anyone know if there's a split-tunnel thing I need to request?

devon: @maya — welcome! :wave: Which network are you connected to (home/office)? Do you see the bastion docs in /startup?

maya: Home WiFi. I followed the quickstart and connected the WireGuard profile. curl to config.internal times out but ping resolves to 10.40.x.x.

oliver: if it resolves but times out, likely egress firewall blocking outbound to private subnets from split-tunnel? We have an egress policy that denies traffic to 10.40.0.0/16 unless device has the "internal-egress" tag. New hires need an exception.

maya: ah okay. How do I get the tag?

oliver: file a short ticket to eng-infra with your device hostname and your user email. We can add a temporary exception. I'll also DM you details.

maya: thanks. ticket created: INF-8672.

infra-bot: Ticket INF-8672 opened by maya. Assigned to devon. ETA 4h.

devon: got it. @oliver can you approve the short-lived exception?

oliver: approved. I've added a policy to allow egress from maya-device01 to 10.40.0.0/16 for 6 hours. Give it a minute to propagate.

maya: still 504 after ~2m. Any immediate workaround? Need to run local migrations pointing at config-service.

samira: While infra updates, you can proxy through the bastion with SOCKS5. SSH into bastion and create a dynamic forward: `ssh -i ~/.ssh/redwood_jump -J jump@bastion.redwood.net -D 1080 maya@bastion`. Then point your app/curl at the SOCKS proxy. Example: `curl -x socks5h://localhost:1080 http://config.internal:8080/health`

maya: ok trying that now... curl returns 200 via SOCKS :tada:. Is this secure enough for running migrations?

samira: It's fine for short-term dev tasks. For DB migrations that touch prod, wait for infra approval and use dedicated VPN/dedicated capacity. Also remember to set `NO_PROXY`/`no_proxy` for local tooling if needed.

devon: infra update: policy change propagated. You should have native access now; can you test without the SSH proxy?

maya: testing... direct curl now 200. Confirmed. Removing SSH tunnel.

maya: Quick follow-ups: 1) how do I avoid this in future on the same device? 2) DNS sometimes resolves wrong when on mobile tethering.

oliver: 1) We'll add your device MAC to device inventory and the onboarding script will tag it automatically next time. Ask people-ops to include device name in the asset request so inventory matches. 2) Tethering tends to bypass corporate DNS. For quick fixes you can add a host entry in `/etc/hosts` for short-term, but we prefer connecting via the WireGuard profile or using the bastion SOCKS when on flaky networks. We'll also file a small doc update in onboarding to call this out.

devon: actionable items: a) eng-infra to add a note in the onboarding checklist about egress tag (oliver) b) devex to add SOCKS recipe to new-hire guide (samira) c) maya to confirm device name in asset request.

maya: noted. thanks everyone, super fast help! :heart:

oliver: welcome aboard, and ping me if anything else pops up.

infra-bot: Ticket INF-8672 updated: status -> Resolved. Reason: temporary exception applied then provisioned to device inventory.
